verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing documents getting a business number set up in minutes, with a new local or toll-free number included per user, so the provisioning core of the story is claimed. Nothing shows searching available inventory by area code. The MCP mention of 'numbers are available' refers to listing existing inboxes, not searching numbers to buy, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented search of available numbers by area code, a documented purchase/selection flow (in-app or API), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the 'in minutes' claim.

support.subject: As a founder, I can search available numbers by area code and buy a local number in minutes

citations.quote: Set up a business number in minutes
One new or ported phone number (local or toll-free) per user
Canadian local and toll-free virtual numbers from anywhere
